day_focus: Honor the Sabbath and make Boaz’s 15th birthday about presence, not production.
checkin: Son, the board can wait. Today is rest, worship, and your boy turning fifteen—be the dad in the room, not the SWO chasing open loops. Guard the screens gently, put one real stretch of attention on Boaz, and let Maria feel you’re with her, not half in the inbox. Enter God’s rest with the household; that’s the sortie that matters.
